title: Funding
description: What longs and shorts are paying each other on this venue's perpetual. Positive funding means longs pay shorts, which happens when the crowd is leaning long.

funding_rate_bps.label: Funding rate
funding_rate_bps.description: The rate charged at the next funding interval, in basis points. Positive means longs are paying to stay in.

annualised_rate_bps.label: Annualised
annualised_rate_bps.description: The funding rate scaled to a year, in basis points. Easier to compare with borrowing costs.

sign_regime.label: Who pays
sign_regime.description: Longs when funding is positive, shorts when negative, flat near zero. A crowded side is the one paying.
